messages:
Tess Alvarado: Weekend idea 37a
Brunch + boardgames + DIY mimosa bar Sunday? casual, bring one topping or a bottle (sparking or juice).
Marco Deng: in. what time?
Tess Alvarado: thinking 11:30am start, food until 1pm then games.
Zara Ibrahim: can do 11:30. I'll bring fresh berries and some sparkling water.
Liam O'Connor: I can bring orange juice + a small champagne-ish bottle. low cost.
Priya Nair: i'll bring gluten-free pastries and label them.
Tess Alvarado: great. please label any allergens. i'll bring extra plastic flutes and a pitcher.
Marco Deng: game suggestions: Ticket to Ride, Sushi Go, Exploding Kittens? short stuff so folks can rotate.
Ellen Park: might be 10 min late but will join. i can bring a light fruit salad.
Tess Alvarado: cap? maybe 18 to keep it cozy.
Marco Deng: RSVP reaction: 44d = in, 615 = maybe, 44e = out.
OpsBot: Event created: "Brunch & Boardgames (DIY Mimosas)" Sunday 11:30 - Common Area. Reminder 2h before.
Zara Ibrahim: accessibility note: i'll reserve a lower table for quieter seating.
Priya Nair: thanks, Zara. also anyone want decaf coffee?
Liam O'Connor: i'll bring a small thermos of decaf.
Tess Alvarado: perfect. RSVP so far: Tess, Marco, Zara, Liam, Priya, Ellen = 6. cap 18.
Marco Deng: playlist rec: easy morning jazz.
Tess Alvarado: will post a tiny playlist on the lounge board. see you Sunday!
